viral_opportunities.snippet:
Author: @Rainmaker1973 | Text: The winner of America’s largest Powerball jackpot is spending $10 million to rebuild the town where he grew up.

Edwin Castro has purchased 15 fire-scorched lots in Altadena, California, the community where he was raised and once rented a room before claiming the record $2 billion prize. The properties were destroyed in the January wildfires, which burned roughly 9,000 structures across the area and displaced thousands of residents.

Castro plans to rebuild mostly
viral_opportunities.author: @Rainmaker1973
viral_opportunities.summary: Powerball winner Edwin Castro buys 15 fire-scorched Altadena lots, pledging $10M to rebuild the town.
viral_opportunities.engagement_angle: Altadena rebuild story without design/insurance hook (bias cap); watch for architect selection or design plans to emerge.

viral_reply.body: Rebuilding 15 lots at once is a rare chance to set a standard — non-combustible assemblies plus WPH Plus detailing measurably change how those homes underwrite later.
